sentences.japanese: チーズは、ウシ、ヤギ、ヒツジやその他の哺乳類の乳から作られる固形の食べ物だ。
sentences.english: Cheese is a solid food made from the milk of cows, goats, sheep, and other mammals.

sentences.japanese: その赤ん坊は乳を飲まされてはじめて泣き止んだ。
sentences.english: It was not until the baby was fed that he stopped crying.

sentences.japanese: そのチーズは羊の乳から作られています。
sentences.english: That cheese is made from sheep's milk.

sentences.japanese: うちの牛は全く乳が出ない。
sentences.english: Our cow doesn't give us any milk.
